Redbook Software | Staff Software Engineer | REMOTE (U.S.) | $200k-$250k

Redbook is the new software of reference for cattle feed yards. We're digitizing the $90B cattle industry, the largest in agriculture. We have built the only cloud-based product in the industry that connects field operations and financials.

Upcoming projects include integration with other #agtech software, tooling to streamline customer onboarding, integrations with hardware, integration with futures market, and much more!

We are a senior team of 5 people, we value autonomy, keep meetings low, and we're fully remote. Our engineers backgrounds include Stack Overflow, Microsoft, Atlassian, Elastic, and ngrok.
